tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground for story pages, Index, Now and the ⌘K panel. Body copy (`ink`, `ink-2`) sits on it.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: The hall's wall behind the doors, and the fill of pills (view switch, theme button, ⌘K button). Concrete adds the wall texture image on top; sky makes it clear so the sky shows.

tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: The floor of the hall and the phone caption panel. Concrete adds the floor texture; sky shows grass. Keep text off the concrete and sky floor: `ink-2` and `ink-3` drop below 4.5:1 there.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, body copy, nav links, the selected view-switch pill fill. 4.5:1 or better on `paper` and `wall` in every theme.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines (company · role · year), ledes on the wall, footer. On `paper` and `wall`; 5:1 in light.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: item numbers, timeline labels. On `paper` and `wall`. In concrete it is 4.1:1 on the textured `wall`: fine for 18px+, keep body copy in `ink-2` there.

tokens.name: ink-far
tokens.usage: Distant, non-essential marks: far doors in fog, dashed placeholder borders. Never for text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: pill borders, dividers, the ⌘K panel outline.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Selected row in ⌘K and quiet filled areas.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The door leaf (the panel that swings open).

tokens.name: reveal
tokens.usage: Door edges and the room's outer falloff behind an open door.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: The warm light inside a room behind a door.

tokens.name: lamp-core
tokens.usage: The brightest spot of a room's light.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Faint dot texture on the dark wall. Off elsewhere.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Phone and laptop bezels around project screens. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: device-edge
tokens.usage: The highlight edge on device bezels.

tokens.name: screen
tokens.usage: An empty device screen before media loads.

tokens.name: runner
tokens.usage: The runner's body colour. Concrete and sky make him glow red (emissive light plus a CSS glow).

tokens.name: tbd-bg
tokens.usage: Highlight behind placeholder copy Suraj still has to write. Remove before launch.

tokens.name: tbd-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `tbd-bg` (7.7:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: The blue working-note box on story pages (draft status, open questions).

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `note-bg` (10:1+).

tokens.name: jones-green
tokens.usage: Jones brand tint in the Jones try-it phone.

tokens.name: jones-green-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `jones-green`.

tokens.name: limit
tokens.usage: The limit/warning state inside the Jones try-it demo only.

styles.name: story-title
styles.usage: The h1 on a story page. Shrinks to 40px on narrow screens.

styles.name: wall-title
styles.usage: A full or short story's title on the wall label.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: I design products and build them, from zero to one.
styles.usage: The intro and end-wall statements. 29px on phones.

styles.name: wall-title-small
styles.usage: Title of a one-line item (no door) on the wall.

styles.name: caption-title
styles.usage: The project title in the phone caption under the hall.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section labels on story pages (left column), in `ink-2`.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: The only designer at an early-stage company.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a story title.

styles.name: fact
styles.usage: The meta line above a story title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Quitting isn’t linear, so the small states mattered as much as the happy path.
styles.usage: Story body copy. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The outcome line and Read/Try links on a wall label.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Everything else: nav, buttons, meta, footer, ⌘K hints. 16px is the floor; nothing on the site is smaller.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the 2D/3D switch and its buttons, the ⌘K button.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The ⌘K search panel.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Company marks on the timeline.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Placeholder highlights (`tbd-bg`).

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The ⌘K panel, together with a 1px `rule` outline.
